set.body:
From the review of p0-readybatch (67afc75b), all low severity:
(1) RunShelf.scala:74's shown-run guard has no studio-core unit test; only the app-level RunInProgressSuite catches its removal.
(2) RunShelf.shown can lag the document after undo of Command.ShowRun (Reducer.scala:451), so a late ready notice for the undone run is suppressed and the Show offer is lost.
(3) The Long decoder accepts both "5" and 5 on input (Protocol.scala:52); enforce the canonical form or document it.
(4) FakeStudyBackend.continuePreview keeps counting a stale preview and emits Ready, which the UI shows although the preview will be refused.
(5) AdmissionPolicySuite:291-332 rewrote the plain two-valid-row occurrence-conflict test; restore that scenario as its own test.
Minor-version negotiation is tracked separately in bd-01M3JH3492J21SKMYYNZM93118.
set.title: Ready-batch review follow-ups: RunShelf unit test, shelf/undo sync, canonical Long input, stale preview counting, occurrence-conflict test
